title: SINFOS: A Parallel Dataset for Translating Sinhala Figures of Speech
findings: The paper's cultural analysis identifies that a category of Sinhala proverbs ('literature-based') originates from classical texts reflecting the influence of Buddhism. The general benchmark findings indicate that while LLMs perform reasonably well, they tend to struggle with culturally distinct and folklore-inspired proverbs, which includes these religiously influenced expressions.
